name: Opik
description: Traces LLM and agent runs, scores them with LLM-as-a-judge and heuristic metrics, and monitors production quality via Python and TypeScript SDKs and 60+ integrations.

skills.name: Agent Trace Logging
skills.description: Captures trace trees of LLM calls, tool executions, and retrieval steps via a track decorator or framework integrations.

skills.name: LLM As Judge Metrics
skills.description: Scores outputs for hallucination, moderation, answer relevance, and context precision with built-in or custom judge metrics.

skills.name: Datasets And Experiments
skills.description: Evaluates applications against versioned datasets as experiments and compares the results in the Opik dashboard.

skills.name: Production Monitoring Rules
skills.description: Applies online evaluation rules to live traces and charts feedback scores, trace counts, and token usage over time.

skills.name: PyTest CI Evaluation
skills.description: Tests LLM pipelines on every commit through the PyTest integration so evaluation results are recorded per CI run.
